summary: Rio Tinto plc and Rio Tinto Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a stock exchange announcement of third quarter 2026 production results. Q3 copper production was 205 kt (flat YoY, -4% QoQ), 9M copper 646 kt (+1%); global iron ore sales 90.8 Mt (+3% YoY), Pilbara sales 85.7 Mt (+2%). Oyu Tolgoi copper rose 27% YoY and Simandou reached a ~10 Mtpa annualised run-rate. The company cites over $2 billion of capital release year-to-date under its $5-10 billion program. This is a routine operating update, not a special situation; no deal terms or advisory are stated.
